natural_text: Negating a universal claim changes the quantifier to existential and negates the predicate.
normalized_statement: not (forall x in X, P(x)) iff exists x in X, not P(x)

natural_text: A conditional is false exactly when its antecedent holds and its consequent fails.
normalized_statement: not (P -> Q) iff (P and not Q)

natural_text: To prove a proposition by contradiction, assume its negation and derive an explicit contradiction.
normalized_statement: assume not P; derive C and not C; conclude P

natural_text: A universally quantified statement can be disproved by one element of the domain for which its predicate is false.
normalized_statement: to refute forall x in S, P(x), exhibit x in S with not P(x)

natural_text: Existence proofs may be constructive, giving an explicit witness, or non-constructive, establishing existence without identifying a witness.
